title: Jasmine Coconut Rice
steps: Rinse rice under cold water until the water runs clear, then drain well.
Bring coconut milk and water to a boil over medium high heat. Season with salt and add rice, then bring back to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 17 minutes
Remove from heat and rest for an additional 15 minutes, covered.
Fluff with a fork and serve.
